hero.tagline: I build and run backend services, integrations and business apps with Python, React and Angular. Currently shipping production systems at Pyansa.

about.title: About
about.p1: I'm a Full-Stack developer focused on integrations, deployments and architecture. At Pyansa I build and run a data integration platform that connects 6+ ERPs and internal systems, an electronic invoicing system (CFDI 4.0) and a warehouse management system, front end to back end.
about.p2: I came to software from manufacturing engineering and QA, so I care about things that keep a system dependable: tests, clear contracts, repeatable deployments and documented decisions.
about.p3: I work spec-first (OpenSpec): I define each change and its acceptance criteria before coding, and keep the decisions documented. I use AI as part of the workflow and review every change before it ships.

projects.title: Projects
projects.intro: Personal projects with public code. Work projects are private and not shown here.

items.cfdi: Web app to load, filter and inspect Mexican CFDI invoice XML files: summaries, taxes, concepts, search and date or amount ranges.
items.viajes: Angular dashboard that loads a CSV of trips and offers interactive charts, filters and a paginated table.
items.notes: Notes app with categories and archive: React single-page front end and a Flask API with migrations.
items.qa: API test automation suite for the Rick and Morty API: status codes, JSON schema and header checks, reports with Allure.
